acceptance_rule.write: Candidate median reduction must exceed max(baseline range, candidate range), and candidate must be faster in all 3 paired rounds.
acceptance_rule.query: Reject increases exceeding max(baseline range, candidate range) for total, filtered, or unfiltered query time.
acceptance_rule.resources: Reject median B/M increases exceeding max(baseline range, candidate range, 1 MiB), checked separately for write/query projects.
acceptance_rule.missing_resources: Do not accept if I/O attribution is unknown.
acceptance_rule.interpretation: Conservative observed-noise rule with n=3; not a statistical significance claim. No best-round selection.

limitations: Local fresh-volume warm-cache workload, not platform score; no platform cache reset/baseline/E conversion.
I/O is per-cgroup on a shared host data device; image/runtime reads may share that device.
Function microbenchmarks are separate diagnostics and never substituted for full-write timings.
